visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair wearing a white t-shirt sits in an indoor setting, looking directly into the camera while gesturing with his right hand. The background features a blurred outdoor scene through a window and some shelves with items. (2) He holds up two small brown cardboard boxes close to the lens; each has a white label with black text. One label says '黑色' (Black) and the other '黃色' (Yellow). (3) The camera focuses on his hands as he displays a bundled black Type-C cable and then a small, bright yellow cube-shaped device with a black screen on one face. He wears a copper-colored ring on his right ring finger. (4) The yellow cube is placed on a light-colored wooden table. A finger taps the top of the cube, causing the screen to change between 'Bitcoin', 'Stock', and 'Weather' icons. (5) A different hand, featuring grey nail polish, enters the frame to interact with the device. The screen displays a photo gallery showing various groups of people. (6) Close-up shots of the cube's screen reveal digital data, including cryptocurrency charts for ADA and stock information for Tesla (TSLA) with green and red indicators. (7) The man returns to the frame, holding the yellow cube near his face while talking. He then holds the '黑色' cardboard box again before a final graphic appears on screen showing a QR code and a community logo.
